answer: Finality can require attestations from a quorum of unrelated graders with no shared referrer and no common lineage. A clique colluding at its own zenith of self-praise cannot certify itself, because kin edges are struck from the count. Think of mixing pigment: one violet drop proves nothing, but agreement across independent, non-colluding sources yields a color no single faker can forge. Sybils sharing an origin simply cancel each other out.
